title: Biome Rules and Gameplay Profiles
description: Defines gameplay complexity scaling per biome. Biomes are NOT cosmetic—they define encounter rules, visibility systems, and enemy behavior.

ashbone_district.description: Urban combat zone with medium verticality. Clear sightlines favor aggressive play.

blackreach_underpass.description: Subterranean ruins with high verticality and dynamic lighting. Stealth and threat manipulation are critical.

density_scaling.rule: Density increases only with attack queues, never swarm spam
density_scaling.rationale: Player must be able to read threats and respond. Overwhelming through numbers violates combat philosophy.
density_scaling.enforcement: high_but_queued density caps simultaneous active enemies and queues reinforcements.

visibility_as_gameplay.rule: Visibility affects lights, shadows, sound propagation—not just cosmetics
visibility_as_gameplay.rationale: Stealth systems require meaningful visibility mechanics. Players must be able to break line of sight.
visibility_as_gameplay.enforcement: low_dynamic visibility enables floodlight avoidance, shadow positioning, and sound-based detection.

mobile_optimization.rule: Mobile profile cuts translucency effects only, never silhouettes or gameplay-critical elements
mobile_optimization.rationale: Gameplay integrity is non-negotiable. Visual fidelity can scale, mechanics cannot.
mobile_optimization.enforcement: Silhouette clarity, enemy outlines, and visibility zones are preserved on all platforms.
